description: Temporarily mute an alert (stops notification delivery). Defaults to 24 hours; pass an ISO-8601 timestamp as until for a custom expiry. Pass the alertId obtained from list_alerts.

until.description: Unmute time in ISO-8601 (e.g. 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z). Omit for 24 hours from now

name: silence_alert
